status_semantics: Closed statuses are limited to their named contract. Plans, downloads, unit tests, and narrower experiments never close a stronger empirical claim.

items.goal: Finite time-consistent NDU control
items.reason: Backward induction is exact over the declared finite action/law support and history-rectangular ambiguity model; floating-point and support limits remain explicit.

items.goal: Executed state-dependent generation and useful refinement
items.reason: Primary paired difference -0.27833614794504397 with strictly negative CI; 50.4232% refine and 54 observed groups contain both actions.

items.goal: Direct NDU training credit to the new refiner
items.reason: 90/90 recorded utility-only steps have finite nonzero refiner gradients. Encoders, initial map and decoders are frozen during this stage.

items.goal: Actual native action/budget/output lifecycle
items.reason: 80 native tests; 24576 formal sessions and 126322 requests bind to executed Torch latents/outputs. This is a research bridge, not the production feature driver.

items.goal: Independent replay and reproducible evidence
items.reason: All formal raw-output and metric replays match; failed development is retained. Gradient source/records are reviewed, not independently retrained.

items.goal: Joint source-dependence model
items.reason: Three declared joint calibration regimes and all 6561 public histories replace a product-of-marginals model. No arbitrary-shift guarantee.

items.goal: Strict continuation advantage over myopic control
items.remaining_acceptance: A new prospectively frozen experiment with enough training seeds and strict paired superiority, if the phenomenon exists.
items.reason: CI upper endpoint is 0; seeds 17/29 are identical to myopic. Do not tune on this confirmation set or reinterpret equality as superiority.

items.goal: Robust control dominates nominal expected loss
items.remaining_acceptance: A separately justified robustness objective and new heldout evidence; expected-loss dominance is not a general theorem.
items.reason: Mean loss is worse by 0.0454762 nominal and 0.0076120 under shift. Worst-case optimization need not improve the nominal mean.

items.goal: Adaptive witness policy adds value over witness alone
items.remaining_acceptance: A new prospectively designed cost/information model where selective querying provides measurable benefit relative to witness-only.
items.reason: All support histories query; outputs/losses equal witness-only and online Linear MACs are about 1.91-1.95 times higher. New evidence is useful; NDU-specific querying advantage is absent here.

items.goal: Recover shared-wrong truth without new information
items.remaining_acceptance: Change the information set with a genuinely informative independently justified source, or narrow the claim.
items.reason: The symmetric eight-class shared-wrong construction implies a 1/7 top-1 upper bound. More optimization cannot remove this information bound.

items.goal: Dynamic output-portfolio reallocation within generation
items.remaining_acceptance: Add observable-state-dependent portfolio/modality allocation to the action space, maintain feasible complete emission, and perform matched independent confirmation.
items.reason: Current feedback trajectory holds the eight-semantic-class condition q fixed and selects STOP/REFINE. q is not a text/audio/image/video resource-allocation vector. Source portfolio selection is a separate finite experiment; it is not a joint dynamic q_t or modality scheduler.

items.goal: Identifiable synthetic risk coefficient
items.reason: Nine fixed-scale Gaussian/logistic profiles have max absolute coefficient error 0.064635; fitted gamma is passed to the actual finite policy.

items.goal: Real or endogenous dynamic preference identification
items.remaining_acceptance: Observed real preference data, identifiable scale/noise model, exogenous interventions or justified dynamics, and independent predictive validation.
items.reason: No real preference data or coupled preference process has been fitted; synthetic gamma recovery does not provide this evidence.

items.goal: Entropic BSDE analytic verification
items.reason: Gaussian analytic U and Z and binomial discretization checked; initial error 0.000312311 at 512 steps.

items.goal: General controlled nonlinear coupled FBSDE solver
items.remaining_acceptance: Specify admissibility, regularity, terminal integrability and coupling; implement a solver and independently validate a nontrivial family.
items.reason: Current solution is an analytic decoupled special case. Z is a martingale coefficient, not a neural parameter gradient.

items.goal: Global optimum of neural training or end-to-end all-modal weights
items.remaining_acceptance: For global claims, a valid structural theorem/certificate; for practical claims, new controlled evidence and intended encoder/decoder utility-gradient coverage.
items.reason: Finite policy optimality does not imply global nonconvex weight optimality; v3 trains the new refiner only. Historical v2 and v3 parameter updates cannot be concatenated into one end-to-end proof.

items.goal: Real captured media to typed four-input tensors
items.reason: One licensed 10.483-second real audiovisual recording, sampled image, and existing human description were decoded and integrity checked. Text bytes are not a semantic text encoder.

items.goal: Natural pretrained codec interfaces
items.reason: Pinned pretrained TAESD image/independent-video-frame roundtrips, T5 encoder/decoder/bounded text generation and DAC integer-code audio reconstruction executed on one licensed fixture. Visible image detail loss, echoed text and audio SNR -2.392409 dB are retained. Audio failure/intermediate attempts are preserved. This closes the named interface contract only; no temporal video model, semantic-quality threshold, shared target-blind generator or natural NDU training is validated.

items.goal: Natural target-blind four-output generation and NDU benefit
items.remaining_acceptance: Licensed paired corpus and source-group split; pretrained adapters; target-blind generator; utility-only gradients and actual feedback; independent matched evaluation.
items.reason: One recorded clip and synthetic weights do not support source-disjoint natural generalization. GPU is not the only missing input.

items.goal: All-modal foundation-model scale and broad validation
items.remaining_acceptance: Broad independent natural tasks/data, intended trainable encoders/decoders, resource receipts and quality/generalization evidence.
items.reason: The finite eight-concept model is a mechanism experiment, not an all-modal foundation model.

items.goal: Hosted execution recovery
items.remaining_acceptance: Dedicated execution and v3 remote reproduction remain separate.
items.reason: New run 39903819841 actually used ubuntu-slim and completed frozen v2 smoke plus 23 tests; artifact digest and result hashes verified. Smoke scientific primary is false and confirmation eligibility is false. This does not change original queued run 39899251197 or close v3 remote/dedicated validation.

items.goal: Dedicated desktop runner execution
items.remaining_acceptance: An authorized online idle runner in trillionnium-android-gpu with self-hosted/linux/x64 labels, repository access and a completed original dedicated job receipt.
items.reason: Accessible connector has no runner administration/service endpoint. Queue state alone does not identify offline/billing/label/permission cause.

items.goal: Production NeuronRuntime model-port integration
items.remaining_acceptance: Implement and bind an actual NeuronFeatureDriver; supply legitimately loaded model assets, execution-derived receipts and independent authorization/attestation; exercise real owner startup/tick before registry promotion.
items.reason: Actual native research bridge is not an authenticated production driver. Nonzero digests or a test-only port cannot substitute for executed weights and authorization.
